unknown_rule: all unknown external names/endpoints/keys/anchors are typed_absence; never self-supplied

common_binding.hash_rule: canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes then lowercase SHA-256; response must bind exact digest and all candidate/layer/axis edges
common_binding.time_rule: RFC3339 from independently trusted source; local OS clock is not authority
common_binding.ack: signed receipt binds request_id, idempotency_key, object digest, decision, trusted time and verifier reference

packets.title: 独立证明人 + 权威接收
packets.separation: 不得同时是源码实现者、PKI owner、环境 provider 或本包 reviewer
packets.verification_command: Get-Content .\response\ehp01.json -Raw | python -B tools/up1_external_closure_r2/authority_intake/cli.py --spool .\local_spool --input .\response\ehp01.json; then independently compare canonical digest and signed ack fields
accept_if: named qualified party and independence/conflict are externally attested
signature covers exact canonical object and declared scope
trusted time/freshness and candidate/source digest match
channel ack binds request and idempotency key
reject_if: unsigned, stale, revoked, replayed or scope mismatch
packets.recover_if: named party supplies complete signed response through a verified channel; no new AD on unchanged inputs
packets.hash_binding: request_id + candidate_id + source_revision/version + canonical_object_sha256 + expected_context + nonce + idempotency_key + attestation_digest + ack_digest

packets.title: 项目 trust root / cert chain / revocation / trusted time / replay
packets.separation: 不得与独立证明人、源码实现者或 intake owner 合并
new_external_inputs: foreign-owner privileged fixture reference only if applicable
accept_if: project anchor and profile are supplied outside bundle and hash-pinned
independent verifier validates path/EKU/key usage/name constraints and exact signature
CRL/OCSP is signed, issuer-bound and fresh
replay ledger accepts nonce/sequence/idempotency exactly once
packets.recover_if: security authority issues a fresh externally anchored package; re-run PKI and replay checks before authority_recheck
packets.hash_binding: external trust_anchor digest + expected_context digest + chain fingerprints + canonical receipt preimage + signature + revocation/time digests + nonce/sequence/idempotency

packets.title: 源码 + 四轴 + G2 权威映射
packets.separation: 源码 owner 不能自证 authority；reviewer 必须独立
accept_if: all layers, axes, source, evidence and G2 mapping have exact same candidate ID
hashes and versions recompute from bytes
no ambiguity, duplicate, orphan, cycle, historical substitution or dirty-boundary drift
reject_if: AD55/AD56 or local hash used as external authority
packets.recover_if: source/G2 authority supplies a complete signed candidate closure; rebuild downstream identities after any source change
packets.hash_binding: candidate + source identity + G1/G2/G3 + four axis material digests + G2 mapping digest + evidence edge graph + external receipt digest

packets.title: 环境 / SBOM / binary provenance
packets.separation: 不得与候选源码 owner、solver operator 或最终 reviewer 合并
accept_if: every imported path/byte and lock/build dependency is listed and hash-bound
environment receipt is candidate-bound and signed
foreign-owner fixture is real and receipt-backed, or explicitly not_executed with deferred status
no secret or credential is included
packets.recover_if: provider returns complete signed closure and independent review; rebind after runtime/source/dependency change
packets.hash_binding: expected_context + candidate/source digests + runtime/import/lock map + binary/provenance/SBOM/license digests + fixture receipt + canonical receipt

global_rule: local preparation, local intake, TEST_ONLY fixture, historical receipt, passing unit test, or parallel packet completion never grants formal credit
